text:
Before lunch, welfare walks stood out in your comments, and we are sorry that your experience with Aurelia Skyways did not meet the level of care you expected for your companion animal. You reported that the cabin support you observed felt uneven and that the handling of your pet seemed less attentive than it should have been during the journey. We take that concern seriously, and I will address it in the same direct manner we use at the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Our standard procedure is to keep the welcome warm and professional from the first contact onward. Every animal is expected to receive patient attention from trained staff, and the cabin team is assigned to monitor animal welfare throughout the flight. When those steps do not feel visible to a traveler, we need to review the service path carefully and correct the gap. Please be assured that your report will be shared with the relevant team so that the handling notes, cabin checks, and handover steps can be reviewed against our routine expectations.

For future travel, I recommend that you contact us before departure if your pet has any comfort needs that may require closer observation. Clear notes help the desk prepare the file, brief the cabin team, and make sure the animal is assessed with the right level of care once boarding begins. If a pet appears unsettled, our staff are instructed to respond promptly, speak calmly, and keep monitoring the animal until the situation stabilizes. This is the standard we expect on every Aurelia Skyways service.

If you would like to continue the discussion, please send the travel details and any observations you want reviewed, and we will pass them through the proper service channel. We cannot change what already happened, but we can use a clear report to improve the next journey and reinforce the process for staff. Your feedback is useful, and it helps us maintain the care standards that should be present every time a companion animal travels with us.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
